scope: Target-blind fresh Stage A candidate manifest for Household post-P1 and BDG2 alternate building/period preparation.

domain_context.domain: hourly multivariate time-series forecasting for PEFT Stage A development replication
domain_context.downstream_decision: decide whether source-period units are ready for a future F0/HEAD/WIDE/LORA_ONLY/JOINT Stage A run without using target loss or forecast performance
domain_context.quality_bar: publication-directed development data gate; temporal leakage zero tolerance; target-blind metadata and availability only

ready_requires: source files exist and hashes are recorded
candidate source-period and target/context series are fixed without target-performance inspection
local PEFT target-label exposure does not overlap the proposed target series and time range
context 336h / horizon 48h split is feasible with train/V/E1/E2 origin counts
aggregate target finite fraction is at least 70% in train, V, E1, and E2
each 48h target origin window has at least 70% finite target cells for the scored target series
all selected channels are nonconstant in the proposed precontext/train/V/E1/E2 intervals
ready_policy.pretraining_overlap_policy: Foundation-model pretraining overlap is recorded. UNKNOWN overlap does not make Stage A development impossible, but it prevents sealed-final claims.

split_design.layout: precontext14 + train91 + gap2 + V31 + gap2 + E1_41 + E2_41 days
split_design.context_target_alignment: origin is first target timestamp; context [origin-336h, origin), target [origin, origin+48h)
split_design.note: This removes the old calibration role for this manifest. It is intentionally separate from the earlier train90/V30/cal20/eval80 contract and must be frozen before any Stage A execution.

candidates.status_reason: [판정] The post-P1 source-period is target-blind and length-feasible, but not READY under the per-origin 48h target-window availability gate. A target-blind origin-exclusion or shorter split policy must be frozen before use.
candidates.stage_a_role: development candidate only; not sealed final

source_provenance.parser: semicolon-delimited minute rows; hourly means retained only when at least 45 finite minutes are available per channel

proposed_period.selection_rule: Earliest block starting at the prior Household P1 end-exclusive timestamp.

availability_summary.blocking_observation: [확인] The train split contains at least one 48h target origin window with 0 finite target fraction under the 45-minute hourly aggregation rule.

origin_gap.reason: [확인] Post-P1 Household contains multi-hour/multi-day missing target runs. A daily-shift scan found no full 222-day post-P1 block through the local source end that satisfies the per-origin 70% gate without origin exclusions.

candidates.next_required_action_before_training: Freeze either a target-blind origin-exclusion policy or a shorter Household split; then regenerate this manifest before any Stage A fit.

candidates.status_reason: [판정] The candidate has fixed target-blind source/period/series, no local PEFT target-label overlap for the selected Bull office meters, feasible L336/H48 train/V/E1/E2 splits, and passes aggregate plus per-origin availability gates.
candidates.stage_a_role: development candidate only; not sealed final

source_provenance.parser: hourly wide electricity CSV; blank cells treated as missing; local-naive timestamps

proposed_period.selection_rule: Exclude previously exposed Eagle/Lamb sites; prefer Office usage to stay close to prior BDG2 office diagnostics; iterate site_id alphabetically; choose the first site whose first four metadata-order office electricity meters pass target-blind availability/nonconstant gates. Bobcat was checked first and failed availability; Bull was the first passing site.

origin_gap.reason: [확인] All train/V/E1/E2 target origin windows pass the 70% finite target-cell gate. E1 last target end equals E2 first origin under half-open windows, so there is no E1/E2 target overlap.

known_prior_bdg2_exposure: Study17 peft_coarse_supervision_v1 used Eagle and Lamb targets/donors over the local BDG2 source family, with fine evaluation truth in 2017-04~2017-06.
Study31/32 peft_contribution_freeze_v1 used Eagle_office_Elias and Eagle_office_Elvis over 2017-05-04~2018-01-01.
exposure_audit.claim_limit: READY only as Stage A development under local target-label exposure audit. Not a clean sealed-final reserve because the BDG2 source family has been inspected and foundation-model pretraining overlap remains UNKNOWN.

candidates.next_required_action_before_training: Freeze this manifest as an input-selection artifact and copy the candidate into the future Stage A plan; do not inspect E1/E2 losses before model and selection rules are sealed.

overall.interpretation: [판정] BDG2 Bull Office can be used as one target-blind prepared Stage A development unit. Household post-P1 still needs a target-blind gap/exclusion or split revision before it is READY.
